Its programmes connect practical learning and recreation with the development of positive relationships. Through shared activities and time in nature, participants explore their abilities, develop confidence, and practise cooperation within a welcoming community that emphasizes personal growth, belonging, and connection with others.

name: YMCA Camp Carter
description: YMCA Camp Carter is an outdoor destination in Fort Worth, Texas, offering summer camps, environmental learning, retreats, and group experiences. Its programmes connect recreation with the YMCA values of caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility. Children, families, and groups explore interests and share experiences, developing confidence, independence, and relationships while spending time outdoors within a community focused on growth and belonging.

name: YMCA Camp Chief Ouray
description: YMCA Camp Chief Ouray provides camp experiences in Colorado's Rocky Mountains, based near Granby. Its programmes include overnight adventures, day experiences, leadership opportunities, and activities for families and groups. Participants explore mountain surroundings and try unfamiliar challenges, developing confidence, independence, and relationships through shared camp life, with supportive instruction encouraging personal growth, responsibility, and a lasting connection with the outdoors.

name: YMCA Camp Chingachgook
description: YMCA Camp Chingachgook is an outdoor center beside Lake George in New York. Its programmes include summer camp, school experiences, retreats, and community activities that connect people with nature and one another. Shared challenges and daily participation encourage confidence, independence, and responsibility, while the camp's community emphasizes youth development, healthy living, and contributions through relationships and learning in the outdoors.

name: YMCA Camp Cosby
description: YMCA Camp Cosby offers overnight camp, outdoor education, family events, and retreats beside Lake Logan Martin in Alabama. Its programme connects recreation with opportunities to learn, explore interests, and develop relationships. Campers and groups share activities and responsibilities in a lakeside setting, building confidence, independence, and teamwork while experiencing the YMCA's emphasis on growth and participation within a supportive community.

name: YMCA Camp Erdman
description: YMCA Camp Erdman provides outdoor learning and camp experiences on Oahu's North Shore in Hawaii. Its programmes include youth camps, school experiences, and family activities that connect participants with local natural environments. Through practical exploration and shared challenges, campers develop confidence, relationships, and an appreciation for the land and ocean while experiencing learning rooted in the island's surroundings and community.

name: YMCA Camp Fitch
description: YMCA Camp Fitch is a camp and outdoor education center beside Lake Erie in Pennsylvania. Its programmes include summer experiences, school learning, retreats, adventure trips, and activities connected with farming and science. Children and groups explore interests and build relationships through practical participation, with a community that emphasizes friendship, achievement, belonging, and the development of perseverance through shared outdoor experiences.

name: YMCA Camp Flaming Arrow
description: YMCA Camp Flaming Arrow was a residential summer camp in Hunt, Texas, associated with the YMCA of Greater San Antonio. Its history centered on outdoor activities, community life, and opportunities for young people to grow in confidence and independence. The camp closed in 2021, so this directory entry is retained as a historical profile rather than an active camp opportunity.

name: YMCA Camp Grady Spruce
description: YMCA Camp Grady Spruce provides summer camps, outdoor education, and retreats in Texas. Its programmes use activities such as paddling, riding, archery, and group challenges to connect learning with outdoor experience. Participants explore interests, practise cooperation, and develop confidence, with shared activities supporting personal growth, environmental understanding, and meaningful relationships within a community that encourages connection with nature and others.

name: YMCA Camp Greenville
description: YMCA Camp Greenville offers overnight summer camp, adventure programmes, and leadership development in the Blue Ridge Mountains. Its community brings children and teenagers together through active experiences and shared camp life. Staff support campers as they explore interests, build friendships, and try unfamiliar challenges, encouraging confidence, independence, cooperation, and a stronger understanding of their abilities through time spent learning together.

name: YMCA Camp Hanes
description: YMCA Camp Hanes provides camp experiences in North Carolina that connect outdoor activities with friendship and personal growth. Its programmes offer opportunities for children and groups to explore interests, participate in shared challenges, and enjoy community traditions. Through practical activities and supportive relationships, participants develop confidence, independence, and teamwork while building connections with one another and the outdoors around them.

name: YMCA Camp Harrison
description: YMCA Camp Harrison offers overnight summer camp in the mountains of North Carolina. Its programme combines outdoor activities with a Christian community focused on faith, fellowship, and personal growth. Campers explore forests, trails, and waterways while taking on shared challenges, developing confidence and independence through supportive relationships, reflection, and opportunities to strengthen their values alongside peers in a natural setting.

name: YMCA Camp Ihduhapi
description: YMCA Camp Ihduhapi provides outdoor experiences near Loretto, Minnesota, on the shore of Lake Independence. Its setting includes woodland, prairie, and wetlands that support exploration and learning. Through camp activities and shared experiences, young people develop skills, confidence, and relationships, with programmes reflecting the YMCA's emphasis on personal growth, community participation, and a thoughtful connection with others and the outdoors.

name: YMCA Camp Jewell
description: YMCA Camp Jewell provides summer camp and outdoor experiences in Connecticut. Its community encourages children to explore their interests, take on unfamiliar challenges, and learn from trying again when activities feel difficult. Shared camp life and supportive counsellors help participants develop confidence, independence, and friendships while practising cooperation, resilience, and responsibility through everyday experiences with peers in an encouraging environment.

name: YMCA Camp Kanata
description: YMCA Camp Kanata offers overnight, day, and leadership camps for children and teenagers in North Carolina. Its programmes connect outdoor activities with shared experiences that encourage confidence and independence. A welcoming community brings together campers from varied backgrounds, helping participants explore interests, develop friendships, and discover their abilities while practising responsibility and cooperation through camp life and learning in nature.

name: YMCA Camp Letts
description: YMCA Camp Letts is an outdoor camp and group destination in Maryland. Its camp community connects experiences away from everyday routines with opportunities for learning, recreation, and personal development. Participants share activities and responsibilities while building relationships with peers and staff, developing confidence, independence, and teamwork through time outdoors and the YMCA's emphasis on caring, respect, and positive community participation.

name: YMCA Camp Mason
description: YMCA Camp Mason offers overnight camps, day camps, and group experiences in New Jersey. Its approach gives children opportunities to explore interests and enjoy outdoor activities within a welcoming community away from everyday digital distractions. School groups and other visitors also use its setting for shared learning, with experiences encouraging confidence, independence, relationships, and thoughtful participation in group life together.

name: YMCA Camp Ockanickon
description: YMCA Camp Ockanickon is the boys' camp within YMCA of the Pines in New Jersey. Its programme connects outdoor activities and community life with opportunities for personal development. Campers explore interests and build relationships while practising independence, responsibility, and cooperation, with the wider organization's approach emphasizing social, emotional, and physical growth through learning and participation in a supportive natural setting.

name: YMCA Camp Orkila
description: YMCA Camp Orkila provides camp experiences on Orcas Island in Washington. As part of the YMCA of Greater Seattle, it connects outdoor activities with opportunities for young people to develop relationships and personal skills. Campers participate in shared experiences, explore interests, and practise responsibility, building confidence and independence while learning alongside peers and staff in an island based camp community.

name: YMCA Camp Roger
description: YMCA Camp Roger provides outdoor camp experiences in Utah's mountain environment. Its programme emphasizes a supportive community where young people can express themselves and take on challenges suited to their comfort and abilities. Shared activities and relationships encourage personal growth, confidence, and cooperation, helping campers practise independence and responsibility while developing connections with others and spending meaningful time in nature.

name: YMCA Camp Sea Gull and Seafarer
description: YMCA Camp Sea Gull and Seafarer provides overnight summer camp experiences in coastal North Carolina. Its programmes emphasize camper choice, skill development, and opportunities to grow through participation in camp life. Young people explore interests and take on increasing responsibility, developing confidence, independence, and friendships while sharing activities and learning alongside others within a community focused on achievement and belonging.

name: YMCA Camp Seymour
description: YMCA Camp Seymour offers outdoor camp and learning experiences near Gig Harbor, Washington. Its programmes connect participants with shared activities, natural surroundings, and opportunities for personal growth. Children and groups explore interests and practise cooperation, with camp experiences encouraging confidence, independence, and positive relationships while reflecting the YMCA's focus on youth development, healthy living, and responsibility toward others within communities.

name: YMCA Camp Shady Brook
description: YMCA Camp Shady Brook provides summer camps, family programmes, retreats, and group experiences in Deckers, Colorado. Campers and visitors develop relationships, explore interests, and take on shared challenges, with programmes encouraging confidence, independence, responsible decision-making, and a sense of belonging through participation in community life.

description: YMCA Camp Sloane offers overnight summer camp in Connecticut, bringing young people together through shared activities and residential camp life. name: YMCA Camp Thunderbird

name: YMCA Camp Widjiwagan

Through practical outdoor learning, participants develop confidence, teamwork, and independence while strengthening respect for themselves, their communities, and the landscapes they travel through and learn from.
